parts.label: Part 4
parts.article:
Part 4. You will hear part of a lecture about a project evaluation method called the After Action Review process.

1st, you have some time to look at questions 31 to 40.

Now listen carefully and answer questions 31 to 40.

In the last lecture, we looked at managing a project to completion. Today, we're going to be looking at a way of judging just how successful your project has been. It's called the After Action Review process.

A typical project review is completed long after the project is finished, and so it's too late to change the outcome.

Wouldn't it be better to evaluate it along the way so you can learn from your mistakes at each stage and improve on them?

It was for this reason that the army devised the After Action Review process as a way for everyone to learn quickly from experiences in the field. Okay, so what are the benefits of using an After Action Review?

Firstly, it's not just limited to very large or very formal projects, but is useful for all sorts of things. For example, you may want to use it to debrief following a staff meeting or any other regular operational function.

In the same manner, it's an extremely effective tool to use following a safety incident and can reveal important lessons so that accidents can be avoided in the future.

So you can see that this would definitely be a positive step for any business. An added benefit of the review is that because the focus is on learning, it really improves communication within working groups.

So let's have a look at what an After Action Review is.

It's a structured session or meeting that does the following. It focuses on the resulting outcomes and the reasons for these. It encourages active participation among the team, and very importantly, emphasizes how vital it is for the team to trust one another.

Here are some of the key elements to remember for when you're conducting an After Action Review.

Where possible, it's really good to have an external person to facilitate the process.

This helps to direct the discussion and can also prevent a stronger member of the review from dominating the others.

Make sure that you encourage active involvement. Often, shy members won't say anything, so one way to encourage them to get involved is to ask people to put their comments in writing.

If they aren't given the opportunity to do this, they may be intimidated by other members of the group.

Another key element is to be aware of the type of questions you ask. In order to make sure that participants don't search for what they think is the perfect answer,

always ask open questions. For example, "What would you do differently next time?"

Ensure that every member of the team has the chance to speak.

It's also important to make sure you write down the specific recommendations made by everyone. But don't forget to pass this information on to non-participating team leaders so that they, too, can learn from the experience.

This is how After Action Reviews contribute to organization-wide learning and improvement.

However, if no one follows up on these recommendations, then the process is wasted.

You should also ensure that the ideas from the After Action Review are incorporated into your business by organizing staff training around them. Finally, the last thing you want is to find that you don't get through everything because you've been talking too much, so make sure you keep a constant eye on the time.

An After Action Review is not something that you should ever plan on conducting in 2 sessions.

Now, before we go on to look at the next type of project review...

That is the end of Part 4. You now have 45 seconds to check your answers to Part 4.

analyses.content: 录音明确提到是军队（army）设计（devised）了这个评估过程。
你可能只听到动词“devised”却忽略了它前面的主语，导致没有精准抓取到究竟是“谁”开发了这个方法。
It was for this reason that the army devised the After Action Review process as a way for everyone to learn quickly from experiences in the field.
录音说明该评估不仅能在员工会议（staff meeting）后使用，同样也非常适合在安全事件（safety incident）后使用。
你可能会在听到“staff meeting”后走神，或者听到“regular operational function”就急着填，要注意“incident”前面紧跟的修饰词才是答案“safety”。

For example, you may want to use it to debrief following a staff meeting or any other regular operational function. In the same manner, it's an extremely effective tool to use following a safety incident and can reveal important lessons so that accidents can be avoided in the future.
录音指出，因为评估的重点（focus）在学习（learning）上，所以它能切实改善工作组内的沟通。
题目中使用的“emphasis on”在录音中被同义替换成了“focus is on”，如果你只死等“emphasis”这个词，就很容易错过答案。
An added benefit of the review is that because the focus is on learning, it really improves communication within working groups.
录音明确说明会议关注最终结果（outcomes）以及产生这些结果的原因（reasons）。
题目把“outcomes”替换成了“results”，如果你听到“outcomes”没反应过来，就容易漏掉紧跟其后的连词“and”带出的答案“reasons”。
It's a structured session or meeting that does the following. It focuses on the resulting outcomes and the reasons for these.
录音强调了团队成员之间相互信任（trust one another）的必要性。
题目中的“stresses the need”对应录音的“emphasizes how vital it is”，如果你不能识别这种句型的灵活替换，就会错过关键的动作词“trust”。
It encourages active participation among the team, and very importantly, emphasizes how vital it is for the team to trust one another.
录音建议，为了鼓励内向的成员参与，可以让他们把想法（comments）用书面（in writing）的形式写下来。
题目要求填入介词“in”后面的具体形式，你可能会听到“comments”就想把它填进去，但忽略了题干“thoughts”已经是“comments”的替换，真正缺少的是表达方式“writing”。
Make sure that you encourage active involvement. Often, shy members won't say anything, so one way to encourage them to get involved is to ask people to put their comments in writing.
录音给出了非常直接的建议：总是问开放式（open）的问题。
这个答案词比较短，而且是在前面一长串关于“防止寻找完美答案”的铺垫后突然出现的，如果你跟丢了前面的长句逻辑，就容易漏听。
Another key element is to be aware of the type of questions you ask. In order to make sure that participants don't search for what they think is the perfect answer, always ask open questions.
录音提醒不要忘记把这些信息（建议）传递给没有参与的团队领导（team leaders）。
你可能会听到前面句子里的“everyone”就误写进去，但题目明确限定了是“other team...”的人，对应录音里非参与的“team leaders”。

It's also important to make sure you write down the specific recommendations made by everyone. But don't forget to pass this information on to non-participating team leaders so that they, too, can learn from the experience.
录音指出要通过组织员工培训（staff training）来把评估中产生的想法融入到业务中。
题目将“staff”替换成了“employees”，并且把动作改为了“provide”，如果你死抠字眼去等“provide”，就会漏掉录音中由“organizing”带出的答案“training”。
You should also ensure that the ideas from the After Action Review are incorporated into your business by organizing staff training around them.
录音在最后提醒，要随时关注（keep a constant eye on）时间（time），以防说得太多。
题干的“check...often”被替换成了“keep a constant eye on”，如果你因为听到“everything”或者“talking”就着急记录，就会错过这句话真正落脚的核心词“time”。
Finally, the last thing you want is to find that you don't get through everything because you've been talking too much, so make sure you keep a constant eye on the time.
